llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的高熵合金可能用于生物医学植入物，但未涉及应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合等核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索CoCrFeNiTi高熵合金的力学与腐蚀性能
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备样品并进行力学与腐蚀测试
summary_zh.result: 获得了该合金的力学和腐蚀特性数据
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试验证材料性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical and corrosion properties of a CoCrFeNiTi-based high-entropy alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated via SLM and subjected to mechanical testing and corrosion experiments.
summary_en.result: The alloy exhibited specific mechanical strength and corrosion resistance characteristics.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through experimental mechanical and corrosion testing.

papers.title: 3D laser shock peening as a way to improve geometrical accuracy in selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Thermomechanical Metallurgy Laboratory – PX Group Chair, Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), CH-2002, Neuchâtel, Switzerland

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究激光冲击强化提高选区激光熔化零件的几何精度，未涉及生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合等核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue properties, surface roughness for osseointegration, or any biomedical context; it focuses solely on geometric accuracy improvement in SLM via post-processing.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高选区激光熔化零件的几何精度
summary_zh.method: 采用3D激光冲击强化技术改善成型件精度
summary_zh.result: 激光冲击强化有效提高了零件的尺寸和形状精度
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量对比冲击前后的几何误差

summary_en.motivation: To improve the geometrical accuracy of parts fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM), which is often limited by residual stress and distortion.
summary_en.method: Three-dimensional laser shock peening (LSP) was applied as a post-processing technique on SLM-manufactured components to reduce deformation and enhance dimensional precision.
summary_en.result: LSP treatment significantly reduced geometrical deviations and improved the overall accuracy of SLM parts.
summary_en.validation: Geometrical accuracy was validated by measuring dimensional errors before and after LSP using coordinate measuring machine or similar methods.
